gameDescriptionHtml:
DragonLoop is a Metroidvania that combines time and map design. Explore the big world in a five-day loop and open up new world lines. Explore a 2D hand-drawn world, engage in fast-paced and refreshing battles, retrieve memories.

Game Features

  • Turn [Boss] into [Elf]! – Defeat the in-game boss to get exclusive elves! Cultivate elves and evolve into combat power!
  • Multi-purpose, use your [imagination]! – Pufferfish, boxes, suction pots… Combat, decryption, skip all-round adaptation, multi-purpose unlocks multiple ways to play!
  • [Ultra-High Speed] Exciting battles! – Use the easy-to-use Ouro rapid dash, combine Ouro skills and Attack, and react as fast as you can!
  • Special [Time]! – Add time to map spaces! [Time] is a special resource! In the 5 days of the loop, explore and open up a new world line!
